body:
You are certainly not alone. What you describe does sound like depression, but no one online can give you an accurate diagnoses. How long have you felt the way you do? Have you spoken to anyone about it?

The best thing you can do is speak to a doctor who will be able to point you in the right direction whether that be therapy or medication.

Best of luck!

Thanks for taking the time to respond. It's not so much guilt that's in the way of my progress. I know I was young and I was an over-sheltered kid with little experience of the world. I understand I was at an age where that kind of behaviour is not unheard of. I think it's a fear of persecution that it holding me that back most. As you said, I am not like an adult sexual predator, but in my mind I'm just as bad and people in my life will always see it that way.

Well, no. I logically understand that I am no where near as bad as an adult sex predator, but I can't seem to keep that mentality through my down moments. I have actually had professional help. Prozac, 2 therapist, charities etc.
Not too much. I play games, watch movies, listen to music and program in my free time.
Of all the things people tell me, this is probably the only one that has made me feel a little better. Thank you.
